title: VAERION Token Record Schema — Constitutional Law
authority: VAERION_IMPLEMENTATION_CONSTITUTION_v1.0 2.2 (token anatomy: exactly seven fields, no more, no fewer)
VAERION_IMPLEMENTATION_CONSTITUTION_v1.0 2.3 (dual naming: identifier and instrumentName resolve to one record)
VAERION_VISUAL_SYSTEM_v1.0.1 §0 (systematic identifier domain.property.variant; instrument name; never separated)
VAERION_IMPLEMENTATION_CONSTITUTION_v1.0 P-4 + VAERION_DESIGN_BIBLE_v1.0 Art. XI (an uncitabled token is void)
Foundation Amendment F-004 (this authority defines law; src/vaerion/registry executes it)

identifier.description: Systematic identifier. Format domain.property.variant; the seven ratified space tokens are the ratified exception, named space.0–space.10 by Visual System §1.2 itself.

instrumentName.description: The human-rememberable name of the thing. Dual naming is inseparable (VS §0).

value.description: The value or formula (Constitution 2.2). A scalar (with unit), a chambered pair for the two chambers (VS §4.1), or a formula referencing other tokens. Values are compiled ONLY from the ratified Visual System text (Constitution 2.1; authority §8).

constraints.description: Scale membership, contrast minima, usage restrictions (Constitution 2.2).

governingCitation.description: At least one citation into ratified law; an uncitabled token is void (P-4; Bible Art. XI).

version.description: The Registry version that introduced the current value (Constitution 2.2, 2.8).
